messages:
Ana Chen: Heads up — Acme field asked about flipping the offer signal for their private offer on the marketplace. They want consumption-based holdbacks to de-risk commit conversions. Can we sketch guardrails?

Mike Lopez: I think we should cap initial holdback at 10% of committed value and scale down after 90 days. Keeps signals positive without over-penalizing. :thumbsup:

Sophia Patel: +1. Also we should curate which SKUs are eligible — exclude low-utilization SKUs and trial SKUs so customers don't get weird bills.

Jordan Kim: Ops flag — need metric hooks to detect gaming (bursting before renewals). Add a continuous smoothing rule and lookback window. I can add a telemetry filter.

Carolyn Reyes: From GTM: add a "graduate to commit" credit path — if customer exceeds X consumption during holdback period, convert portion of holdback into conversion credit for next term.

Ana Chen: Love that. Also want a short consumer-facing FAQ and an internal ops playbook. Who can draft docs? 

Mike Lopez: I can put together a quick playbook this week. Will include:
- rules for holdback pct and taper schedule
- SKU inclusion/exclusion checklist
- telemetry signals and alert thresholds
- proposed messaging snippets for field & ACs

Sophia Patel: Sample messaging: "We’ll hold back 10% of committed credits for the first 90 days to ensure expected consumption; credits are applied back pro rata or converted to renewal credit if usage exceeds thresholds." Keep it simple.

Jordan Kim: Ops TODO: add metric rule: `metering_alert: { window_days:30, smoothing_pct:0.2, burst_threshold:3x }` — I’ll prototype in infra repo and ping @mp_bot when ready.

mp_bot: deploy-preview created: https://ci.redwood.com/preview/holdback-telemetry-3421 — tests passed.

Carolyn Reyes: Timeline idea: week 0 announce to SI partners + docs, week 1 internal enablement, week 2 limited private offer pilot, week 6 evaluate and widen. Thoughts?

Ana Chen: Agree. Let's also lock in renewal conversion credit formula before pilot: propose min(convert_pct, holdback_pct) where convert_pct = min(75%, consumed_pct_over_commit).

Mike Lopez: I'll add formulas + example calc in the playbook.

Sophia Patel: Can we add a field note about marketplace listing language? short legal-approved snippet: "Usage-based holdback applied for initial term. See partner terms for details." I'll loop legal.

Ana Chen: Cool. If no objections, I'll move this to a doc and tag outreach + SI leads. :rocket:

Jordan Kim: No objections from infra.

Carolyn Reyes: No objections from GTM.

Mike Lopez: Send me the doc link when ready, I'll review the ops section.

Ana Chen: Will do — thanks team! :white_check_mark:
